mentions.text:
Few interesting earnings setups I'm watching today.

1) $FLNC - The largest standalone battery storage integrator in the West. ~$2.7B market cap against a $5.6B contracted backlog. 

After their last earnings, the stock surged 40% even though they missed revenue. They announced master supply agreements with two hyperscalers. 

CEO said the first purchase order was expected "within the third quarter." That quarter ended June 30. The FLNC call is scheduled tommorow morning, but in their last earnings they disclosed the hyperscaler contracts in the press release. 

2) $VIAV / $VIAG - Every transceiver that ships has to be tested. VIAVI owns the optical test market and has cleared the top end of its own guidance four quarters straight.

The stock has shot up double digits after each the last 4 earnings. Testing peers $AEHR, $COHU and $FORM have all printed strong quarters since. Pretty clear test demand continues to run hot.

3) $TTMI / $TTMX - The only publicly traded U.S. pure play PCB manufacturer. TTMI is a the largest US domestic manufacturer for AI PCBs, The PCB book to bill hit 1.60 in May, best in 25 years. Upstream PCB players such as (Unimicron, Samsung Electro-Mech) are up 400-700% in H1 and trade at 56-74x forward TTMI is at 26x, PEG 0.36, +51% to the $212 consensus. 

Basically the last layer in the AI PCB chain that hasn't re-rated. Plus the DoW ANPR from July 2 bans Chinese PCBs in defense systems from Jan 1 2027 and TTMI is the only scaled ITAR-certified US shop. They supply Nvidia too.
